title: SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
title_zh: SHUSH：面向主动视频助手的发言感知奖励设计
abstract_en: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions. We identify this failure mode in MMDuet2, whose proactive area-under-the-curve (PAUC) reward promotes timely responses but does not price the number of emissions. We show analytically that this makes additional responses weakly penalized or effectively free, systematically encouraging over-emission. We then propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations, using exclusive span--emission matching to price false emissions and missed spans. Under MMDuet2's training recipe, our policy on the visual subset of OmniPro replies 2.5x less often than MMDuet2 while raising timing F1 from 0.259 to 0.396 and content-aware F1 from 0.103 to 0.154; a more conservative variant cuts replies by 82.5% and raises precision from 0.161 to 0.418. On ProactiveVideoQA, the same reward adds replies where the baseline is nearly silent, and PAUC ranks a heavily over-emitting policy second despite near-last F1, because it is insensitive to response count. Our results indicate that proactive assistants should be trained and evaluated with objectives that price emissions.
abstract_zh: 主动视频助手不仅要决定说什么，还要判断何时开口。现有强化学习目标可以奖励及时、正确的回答，却可能忽略发言次数，从而鼓励不必要或重复的回应。论文从理论上表明，MMDuet2 使用的主动响应曲线下面积（PAUC）奖励对额外回应的惩罚很弱，甚至不产生惩罚，因此容易导致过度发言。为此，SHUSH 针对以时间区间标注的任务提出一种考虑发言次数的 F1 奖励，通过将标注区间与实际回应进行一对一匹配，同时惩罚多余回应与漏答。在沿用 MMDuet2 训练方案的情况下，该方法在 OmniPro 视觉子集上的发言次数降至基线的约 40%，时机 F1 从 0.259 提升至 0.396，内容感知 F1 从 0.103 提升至 0.154。在 ProactiveVideoQA 上，同一奖励则让几乎不发言的基线策略增加了回应。这表明，显式计入发言次数并非一味压低频率，而是有助于平衡多答与漏答。
key_points_zh: MMDuet2 的 PAUC 奖励偏重回应时机，却未显式计入发言次数，使额外回应几乎没有代价。
SHUSH 通过标注区间与回应的一对一匹配计算 F1 奖励，避免重复回应因命中同一区间而反复得分。
在 OmniPro 视觉子集上，发言次数降至基线的约 40%，时机 F1 从 0.259 升至 0.396，内容感知 F1 从 0.103 升至 0.154。
更保守的变体将发言次数减少 82.5%，精确率从 0.161 提升至 0.418。
在 ProactiveVideoQA 上，新奖励让几乎沉默的基线增加回应；PAUC 却将一个严重过度发言、F1 接近垫底的策略排在第二。
